description.text:
CohereLabs/tiny-aya-earth fine-tuned with full fine-tuning (DeepSpeed ZeRO-3) on israel/AfriGuard-inst: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt, and the target is <safety>…</safety> <category>…</category> <response>…</response>.

Its plain counterpart (same base and config) is adzcai/AfriGuardPlain-tiny-aya-earth-full.

Training config: examples/train_full/afriguard_inst_tiny-aya-earth_full_sft.yaml in the AfriGuard-model (LlamaFactory) repo, the tiny-aya-global setup (afriguard_tinyaya_full_sft.yaml) with only the base model and output paths changed; 1 epoch, 1 GPU, cohere chat template, loss on the response only.

quotes: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt
<safety>safe|unsafe</safety> <category>top_category (always, for safe and unsafe prompts)</category> <response>final reply</response>

serving.notes: config.json is Cohere2ForCausalLM with max_position_embeddings 8192 and no vision_config. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; its model_max_length is the tokenizer sentinel 1e30. generation_config.json sets bos, eos, and pad ids only. trainer_state.json records global_step 11577, train_batch_size 1, epoch 1.0. ceil(46306/4) is 11577, matching total_train_batch_size 4 on the train split. The card prose says 1 GPU; the hyperparameter block says distributed_type: multi-GPU. No adapter file.
